storyPreview.title: The Clockwork Swan Affair
storyPreview.summary: SirLocked and his companion are invited to the riverside city of Bellweather for the unveiling of a marvelous automaton: a silver swan said to write prophecies with its beak. When the swan’s creator vanishes moments before the demonstration and the machine produces a message accusing one of the guests, the evening turns into a careful hunt through alibis, hidden mechanisms, and old resentments. The case is built for cooperative deduction, with one investigator following social contradictions while the other examines physical clues and curious devices.
storyPreview.setting: Bellweather, a fog-laced canal city famous for watchmakers, music halls, and private invention salons. The mystery unfolds over one rain-soaked night during an exclusive exhibition at Halcyon House, a glass-domed mansion overlooking the river, with later leads reaching nearby workshops, service passages, and the moonlit canal docks.
storyPreview.openingIncident: At the stroke of nine, the assembled guests gather to witness the Clockwork Swan perform for wealthy patrons. Instead, the lights fail, the machine shudders to life on its own, and its silver beak scratches a troubling accusation onto a strip of paper. When the lamps are restored, the inventor is gone, his workroom is locked from within, and a trail of strange clues suggests either a staged disappearance, a brilliant crime, or a machine obeying instructions no one admits giving.
storyPreview.tone: Elegant, atmospheric, and puzzle-forward, with a mix of gaslit intrigue, theatrical misdirection, dry wit, and mounting suspicion. The danger is real, but the focus is on observation, teamwork, and untangling conflicting stories rather than horror or grim violence.
storyPreview.playerPromise: Players can expect a medium-difficulty cooperative investigation across four focused scenes: interviewing a colorful cast, inspecting a locked workshop, tracing mechanical clues through Bellweather’s nocturnal streets, and confronting the truth behind the swan’s mysterious message. The case rewards shared note-taking, comparing timelines, spotting false assumptions, and revisiting clues that gain new meaning later.
suspectTeasers: Lady Maribel Quince, the exhibition’s patron, whose fortune depends on the swan impressing the right investors.
Orin Vale, a rival automaton maker with a polished smile and a history of public humiliation.
Professor Selda Morcant, a scholar of mechanical logic who insists the machine’s message is impossible.
Pip Tallow, the inventor’s apprentice, who knows every gear in the house but claims to have been sent away at the crucial moment.
Captain Rusk Fen, a canal security officer hired for the gala, whose official report may omit more than it includes.
